Allow.SqlRouting.exact_request: ∀ {p : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {r : Allow.SqlRouting.Report}, Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p r → r.sql = p.sql
Allow.SqlRouting.pinned_identity: ∀ {p : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {r : Allow.SqlRouting.Report}, Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p r → r.binary = p.binary ∧ r.profile = p.profile ∧ r.policy = p.policy
Allow.SqlRouting.mismatch_denied: ∀ {p : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {r : Allow.SqlRouting.Report}, r.sql ≠ p.sql → ¬ Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p r
Allow.SqlRouting.binary_mismatch_denied: ∀ {p : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {r : Allow.SqlRouting.Report}, r.binary ≠ p.binary → ¬ Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p r
Allow.SqlRouting.profile_mismatch_denied: ∀ {p : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {r : Allow.SqlRouting.Report}, r.profile ≠ p.profile → ¬ Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p r
Allow.SqlRouting.parser_failure_denied: ∀ {p : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {r : Allow.SqlRouting.Report}, r.success = false → ¬ Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p r
Allow.SqlRouting.isOpaque_denied: ∀ {p : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {r : Allow.SqlRouting.Report}, r.isOpaque = true → ¬ Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p r
Allow.SqlRouting.cache_exact: ∀ {p : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {e : Allow.SqlRouting.CacheEntry}, Allow.SqlRouting.cacheReuse p e → p = e.request ∧ Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p e.report
Allow.SqlRouting.execute_accepted: ∀ {s : Allow.SqlRouting.State} {name : String} {p : Allow.SqlRouting.Portal}, Allow.SqlRouting.Reachable s → Allow.SqlRouting.execute s name = some p → Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p.request p.report
Allow.SqlRouting.denial_witness: ¬ Allow.SqlRouting.admitted Allow.SqlRouting.sampleRequest { Allow.SqlRouting.sampleReport with isOpaque := true }
Allow.SqlRouting.parse_bind_execute: ∀ (s : Allow.SqlRouting.State) (st : Allow.SqlRouting.Statement) (name : String), Allow.SqlRouting.Reachable s → Allow.SqlRouting.admitted st.request st.report → Allow.SqlRouting.Reachable (Allow.SqlRouting.bind (Allow.SqlRouting.parse s st) name st) ∧ Allow.SqlRouting.execute (Allow.SqlRouting.bind (Allow.SqlRouting.parse s st) name st) name = some ⟨name, st.request, st.report⟩
Allow.SqlRouting.derivation_failure_deni: ∀ {p : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {r : Allow.SqlRouting.Report}, r.derivation = false → ¬ Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p r
Allow.SqlRouting.preservation_failure_de: ∀ {p : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {r : Allow.SqlRouting.Report}, r.preserved = false → ¬ Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p r
Allow.SqlRouting.native_execute_provenan: ∀ {s : Allow.SqlRouting.State} {name : String} {q : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {r : Allow.SqlRouting.Report}, Allow.SqlRouting.Reachable s → Allow.SqlRouting.nativeExecute s name q r → Allow.SqlRouting.admitted q r ∧ ∃ st, s.statements.find? (fun x => x.name == name) = some st ∧ Allow.SqlRouting.admitted st.request st.report
Allow.SqlRouting.native_unknown_denied: ∀ {s : Allow.SqlRouting.State} {name : String} {q : Allow.SqlRouting.Request} {r : Allow.SqlRouting.Report}, s.statements.find? (fun x => x.name == name) = none → ¬ Allow.SqlRouting.nativeExecute s name q r
Allow.SqlRouting.native_prepare_bind: ∀ (s : Allow.SqlRouting.State) (p : Allow.SqlRouting.NativePrepare) (portal : String), Allow.SqlRouting.Reachable s → Allow.SqlRouting.admitted p.statement.request p.statement.report → Allow.SqlRouting.bodyPart p → Allow.SqlRouting.Reachable (Allow.SqlRouting.bind (Allow.SqlRouting.nativePrepare s p) portal p.statement) ∧ Allow.SqlRouting.execute (Allow.SqlRouting.bind (Allow.SqlRouting.nativePrepare s p) portal p.statement) portal = some ⟨portal, p.statement.request, p.statement.report⟩
Allow.SqlRouting.pending_blocks_source: ∀ (s : Allow.SqlRouting.CycleState) (cycle : Nat), cycle ∈ s.pending → ¬ Allow.SqlRouting.sourceAllowed s
Allow.SqlRouting.unvalidated_retains: ∀ (s : Allow.SqlRouting.CycleState) (ack : Nat), Allow.SqlRouting.completeCycle s ack false = s
Allow.SqlRouting.completed_retains_newer: ∀ (s : Allow.SqlRouting.CycleState) (ack cycle : Nat), cycle ∈ s.pending → ack < cycle → cycle ∈ (Allow.SqlRouting.completeCycle s ack true).pending
Allow.SqlRouting.completed_removes_older: ∀ (s : Allow.SqlRouting.CycleState) (ack cycle : Nat), cycle ≤ ack → cycle ∉ (Allow.SqlRouting.completeCycle s ack true).pending
